meta.name: Amityville II The Possession
meta.description: Anthony and Dolores Montelli, along with their four children, move into their dream house in Amityville and are immediately plagued by a string of paranormal experiences. When the abusive Anthony wrongly places the blame on the children, Dolores recruits a local Catholic priest to exorcise the house.
meta.slogan: If these walls could talk...They would shriek!
